resources.string: Seek Thumbnails
Preview pictures above the seek bar while you seek
Seek Thumbnails
Shows a preview picture above the seek bar while you seek. Pictures are made on this TV from the video itself

"Works on: movies and shows in the main player (including streamed HLS links), your recordings, sports replays and highlights, catch-up, and rewinding Live TV (the pause buffer).\nCatch-up: pictures come from the part saved with Faster Catch-Up Skipping, or straight from the provider for streamed (HLS) catch-up.\nDoesn't work on: torrents, DASH links, or protected streams."
This device has limited memory. Thumbnails may cause stutter. If they do, they pause by themselves and the seek bar says so.
Include 4K and HDR

Also makes thumbnails for 4K and HDR videos. Starts on for devices with plenty of memory and off for lower-end ones, but you can turn it on anywhere and try it. 4K thumbnails may stutter or not work on lower-end devices, and use more data. Pictures of HDR videos can look washed out. Streamed links use their smallest version, so this rarely matters for them
When to Make Thumbnails
Only When Paused or Seeking
The lightest choice: nothing is made while the video just plays
While Watching
Also made in the background while the video plays, when it has loaded well ahead
Right Away
The whole video, from the start, as soon as it opens. Uses the most data
Storage Limit
Saved thumbnails take up to this much space; the videos watched longest ago are cleared first
